question: Why did Jesus give himself for us, according to Titus 2:14?
options: To redeem us from all wickedness and purify a people eager to do good
To make us rulers of Crete
To start a new law of food
To show his power to Rome
explanation: Jesus gave himself to redeem us from all wickedness and to purify for himself a people that are his very own, eager to do what is good.
